requirement_text: Faculties shall be able to participate in forums, blogs, and discussions.
user_story: As a faculty member, I want to take part in forums, blogs and discussions, so that I can exchange views with others.
technical_task: Provide forums, blogs and discussions in which faculty members can participate.
acceptance_criteria: Given a forum, blog or discussion, when a faculty member opens it, then the faculty member can read it.
Given a forum, blog or discussion, when a faculty member posts, then the post is published there.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to apply lenses, set a timer, enable gridlines, enable flash, and then capture a selfie or photo.
user_story: As a user, I want to apply lenses, set a timer, enable gridlines and flash, and then take a selfie or photo, so that I can control how the picture is taken.
technical_task: Offer lens effects, a timer, gridlines and flash options in the camera screen before a selfie or photo is captured.
acceptance_criteria: Given the camera screen, when the user applies a lens, sets a timer, or enables gridlines or flash, then the setting is applied.
Given the settings are applied, when the user captures a selfie or photo, then the picture is taken with those settings.

requirement_text: The Development Team shall perform weekly integrations of the [SYSTEM NAME] system and deploy these system updates to the Staging environment.
rationale: The text contains an unfilled placeholder, "[SYSTEM NAME]".
clarification_questions: What is the actual system name, given the text contains the placeholder "[SYSTEM NAME]"?
Which updates are deployed to the Staging environment?

requirement_text: It might be a good assumption to implement a parameter which allows larger residuals for segments which are further away, due to the angular error of radar sensor.
rationale: "It might be a good assumption" is a suggestion, not a requirement, and no values are given.
clarification_questions: Is a parameter for larger residuals required or only suggested?
How much larger should the residual be for segments further away?

requirement_text: User shall be able to log in to the mobile application after registering, with the option for automatic login in the future.
user_story: As a registered user, I want to log in to the mobile application after registering, with automatic login possible later, so that I can get in quickly.
technical_task: Allow login to the mobile application after registration and provide an option for automatic login in the future.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user who has registered, when the user logs in to the mobile application, then access is granted.
Given a user who has logged in before, when the user chooses automatic login, then the user is logged in automatically in the future.
rationale: Role assumed: registered user. "In the future" is read as later sessions.

requirement_text: Each flight NE shall dissipate no more than 35 Watts.
requirement_text_raw: Each flight NE shall (3.2.3.1.2.11) dissipate no more than 35 Watts.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want each flight NE to dissipate no more than 35 Watts, so that its heat load is bounded.
technical_task: Limit the power dissipation of each flight NE to 35 Watts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a flight NE in operation, when its power dissipation is measured, then it is no more than 35 Watts.
Given a measurement above 35 Watts, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Consumers shall be able to purchase agricultural products by searching the database for items for sale, and upon successful search, be redirected to the search results page.
user_story: As a consumer, I want to search the database for agricultural products for sale and be taken to the results page, so that I can buy what I find.
technical_task: Provide product search over the database of items for sale and redirect to the search results page after a successful search.
acceptance_criteria: Given agricultural products for sale, when the consumer searches the database, then matching items are found.
Given a successful search, when it completes, then the consumer is redirected to the search results page.

requirement_text: The system shall remind the user of the task with their chosen ringtone.
user_story: As a user, I want to be reminded of a task with my chosen ringtone, so that I notice the reminder.
technical_task: Play the ringtone selected by the user when a task reminder is due.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task with a reminder and a chosen ringtone, when the reminder is due, then the chosen ringtone plays.
Given two tasks with different ringtones, when each reminder is due, then each plays its own ringtone.

requirement_text: The system shall comply with XHTML and CSS standards (Developer).
user_story: As a developer, I want the system to comply with XHTML and CSS standards, so that pages render consistently.
technical_task: Write the pages in standards-compliant XHTML and CSS.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system's pages, when their markup is validated, then it complies with XHTML standards.
Given the system's style sheets, when they are validated, then they comply with CSS standards.

requirement_text: System shall support version control and revision history tracking for files and log book entries.
user_story: As a researcher, I want version control and revision history for files and log book entries, so that I can see and recover earlier versions.
technical_task: Track versions and keep a revision history for files and log book entries.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file or log book entry, when it is changed, then a new version is recorded in its revision history.
Given a revision history, when the user opens it, then earlier versions can be seen.

requirement_text: The user may try three times.
rationale: The sentence has no object, so the behaviour is unknown.
clarification_questions: What may the user try three times (for example login or answering a security question)?
What happens after three failed tries?

requirement_text: User shall experience a fully dynamic interface where data is fetched from the database.
clarification_questions: What does "fully dynamic" mean in measurable terms?
Which data must be fetched from the database?

requirement_text: User shall be able to receive predictions as top 5 recommendations relevant to their data.
user_story: As a user, I want predictions as top 5 recommendations relevant to my data, so that I see the best suggestions first.
technical_task: Return the top 5 recommendations relevant to the user's data as predictions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's data, when the user requests predictions, then 5 recommendations are returned.
Given the 5 recommendations, when they are shown, then they are relevant to the user's data.
rationale: Role assumed: user. How relevance is computed is not stated.

requirement_text: On detection of a message integrity error at the CNG the CNG shall discard the message.
user_story: As a network operator, I want the CNG to discard a message when it detects a message integrity error, so that corrupted messages are not forwarded.
technical_task: Discard any message in which the CNG detects an integrity error.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message with an integrity error, when the CNG detects it, then the message is discarded.
Given a message without an integrity error, when it reaches the CNG, then it is not discarded for this reason.

requirement_text: It shall stay in TNR mode indefinitely until a successful TNR exchange is observed.
requirement_text_raw: It shall (3.2.2.4.2) stay in TNR mode indefinitely until a successful TNR exchange is observed.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the unit to stay in TNR mode until a successful TNR exchange is observed, so that it does not leave TNR early.
technical_task: Keep the unit in TNR mode with no time limit until a successful TNR exchange is seen.
acceptance_criteria: Given the unit is in TNR mode, when no successful TNR exchange has been observed, then it stays in TNR mode.
Given the unit is in TNR mode, when a successful TNR exchange is observed, then it may leave TNR mode.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "It" is not named in the sentence.

requirement_text: The failed channel, provided it is recoverable, shall be recovered in less than 1.5 minutes.
requirement_text_raw: The failed channel, provided it is recoverable, shall (3.1.15) be recovered in less than 1.5 minutes.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want a recoverable failed channel recovered in less than 1.5 minutes, so that capacity returns quickly.
technical_task: Recover a failed channel, if it is recoverable, within less than 1.5 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failed channel that is recoverable, when recovery runs, then it completes in less than 1.5 minutes.
Given a failed channel that is not recoverable, when recovery is attempted, then this time limit does not apply.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to create accounts and log in to the server.
user_story: As a new user, I want to create an account and log in to the server, so that I can use it.
technical_task: Provide account creation and login for the server.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration page, when the user creates an account, then the account is created.
Given an existing account, when the user logs in to the server, then access is granted.

requirement_text: User shall be able to initiate user password verification.
user_story: As a user, I want to start verification of my password, so that I can confirm it is correct.
technical_task: Provide an action that starts password verification for the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user chooses to verify the password, when verification starts, then the password is checked.
Given a verified password, when the check completes, then the user is told whether it is correct.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "User password verification" is not explained further.

requirement_text: Customer shall view grocery items by entering keywords in the search option.
user_story: As a customer, I want to find grocery items by entering keywords in the search option, so that I can shop quickly.
technical_task: Add a keyword search over grocery items.
acceptance_criteria: Given grocery items, when the customer enters a keyword in the search option, then matching items are shown.
Given a keyword that matches nothing, when the customer searches, then no items are shown.

requirement_text: The details of the bolts and the tolerance design and mounting location between rotor hub flange and rotor hub is designed by the customer.
user_story: As a project manager, I want the customer to design the details of the bolts and the tolerance design and mounting location between the rotor hub flange and the rotor hub, so that responsibility is clear.
technical_task: Assign to the customer the design of the bolt details and of the tolerance design and mounting location between the rotor hub flange and the rotor hub.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bolts, when the design is delivered, then their details were designed by the customer.
Given the tolerance design and mounting location between the rotor hub flange and the rotor hub, when the design is delivered, then it was designed by the customer.

requirement_text: The system shall employ encryption for user data and financial transactions, following industry security standards.
user_story: As a user, I want my data and financial transactions encrypted following industry security standards, so that they are protected.
technical_task: Encrypt user data and financial transactions in line with industry security standards.
acceptance_criteria: Given user data, when it is stored or sent, then it is encrypted.
Given a financial transaction, when it is processed, then it is encrypted following industry security standards.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The standards are not named.

requirement_text: The Flight Route Plan, as a minimum, shall include AV flight path information, Loss of Link plan, AV VCR control tasking (if applicable to the selected AV), and data link control information.
user_story: As an operator, I want the Flight Route Plan to include AV flight path information, a Loss of Link plan, AV VCR control tasking and data link control information, so that the route is fully described.
technical_task: Include in the Flight Route Plan at least AV flight path information, a Loss of Link plan, AV VCR control tasking (if applicable to the selected AV) and data link control information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Flight Route Plan, when it is created, then it includes AV flight path information and a Loss of Link plan.
Given a Flight Route Plan for an AV to which VCR control applies, when it is created, then it includes AV VCR control tasking and data link control information.
rationale: Role assumed: operator. "As a minimum" means more content is allowed.

requirement_text: The product shall be used in office environments.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall be used in office environments.'
rationale: The sentence describes the usage setting and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is the product limited to office environments, and what must it do to suit them?
Are there conditions (noise, temperature) that define an office environment?

requirement_text: Backup power supply must be available for the server to ensure continuous operation in case of power failure.
user_story: As an administrator, I want a backup power supply for the server, so that it keeps running in a power failure.
technical_task: Provide a backup power supply for the server.
acceptance_criteria: Given a power failure, when the main power is lost, then the backup power supply keeps the server running.
Given the server is running on backup power, when main power returns, then the server continues without interruption.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. The backup duration is not given.

requirement_text: Clicking 'Submit' produces a report for each encounter in the date range and shows patient demographics and insurance information as well as the billing codes and amounts.
requirement_text_raw: Clicking 'Submit' produces a report for each encounter in the date range  and shows patient demographics and insurance information  as well as the billing codes and amounts.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want to click Submit to get a report for each encounter in a date range with patient demographics, insurance information, billing codes and amounts, so that I can review billing.
technical_task: Generate a report on Submit that lists each encounter in the date range with patient demographics, insurance information, billing codes and amounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a date range, when the user clicks Submit, then a report is produced for each encounter in the range.
Given a report, when it is displayed, then it shows patient demographics, insurance information, billing codes and amounts.

requirement_text: The system shall ensure the information link is clearly visible, clickable in one action, and functions as a link.
user_story: As a visitor, I want the information link clearly visible and clickable in one action, so that I can reach the information easily.
technical_task: Make the information link visible, activate it with a single click and have it work as a link.
acceptance_criteria: Given the page, when it is displayed, then the information link is clearly visible.
Given the information link, when the user clicks it once, then it opens the linked information.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. "Clearly visible" is not defined further.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall report rate group over-runs to the application via an API service for incorporation in the telemetry data stream.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS029] report rate group over-runs to the application via an API service for incorporation in the telemetry data stream.
user_story: As an application developer, I want the scheduler to report rate group over-runs through an API service, so that over-runs appear in the telemetry data stream.
technical_task: Expose rate group over-runs to the application through a scheduler API service so they can be added to the telemetry stream.
acceptance_criteria: Given a rate group over-run, when the scheduler detects it, then it reports it to the application through an API service.
Given the reported over-run, when the application builds telemetry, then it can be incorporated in the telemetry data stream.

requirement_text: However, the FTSS SW shall notify the application software if the 5th ICP’s heartbeat ceases to exist.
requirement_text_raw: However, the FTSS SW shall (3.3.2.42) notify the application software if the 5th ICP’s heartbeat ceases to exist.
user_story: As a software developer, I want the FTSS SW to notify the application software when the 5th ICP's heartbeat ceases, so that the application knows the ICP is gone.
technical_task: Send a notification to the application software when the heartbeat of the 5th ICP stops.
acceptance_criteria: Given the heartbeat of the 5th ICP ceases, when the FTSS SW detects it, then the application software is notified.
Given the heartbeat of the 5th ICP continues, when the FTSS SW checks it, then no notification is sent.
rationale: Role assumed: software developer. The garbled apostrophe in the source was read as "ICP's".

requirement_text: Resumes will be imported directly from an existing database.
user_story: As a recruiter, I want resumes imported directly from an existing database, so that I do not enter them again.
technical_task: Import resumes directly from an existing database.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing database of resumes, when the import runs, then the resumes are imported.
Given an imported resume, when it is viewed, then it matches the source record.

requirement_text: The FTPP system shall be capable of powering up and operating with any combination of 3 of the 5 FCR's active.
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP system shall (3.1.18) be capable of powering up and operating with any combination of 3 of the 5 FCR's active.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTPP system to power up and operate with any combination of 3 of the 5 FCRs active, so that it works with reduced hardware.
technical_task: Support power-up and operation with any 3 of the 5 FCRs active.
acceptance_criteria: Given any combination of 3 of the 5 FCRs active, when the FTPP system powers up, then it powers up.
Given any combination of 3 of the 5 FCRs active, when the FTPP system operates, then it operates.

requirement_text: The sensor shall deliver fewer than 1 false alarm sensor object with Obj_LongDoubleFusion_Qual set continuously to 1 equal LOW or 2 equal HIGH per hour in all ODAs, where the number of sensor cycles the false alarm is delivered as sensor object is less than or equal to 2.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the sensor to deliver fewer than 1 false alarm sensor object per hour in all ODAs, so that false alarms are rare.
technical_task: Limit false alarm sensor objects with Obj_LongDoubleFusion_Qual continuously set to 1 (LOW) or 2 (HIGH) to fewer than 1 per hour in all ODAs, counting only false alarms delivered for no more than 2 sensor cycles.
acceptance_criteria: Given Obj_LongDoubleFusion_Qual set continuously to 1 (LOW) or 2 (HIGH), when the sensor runs in all ODAs, then it delivers fewer than 1 false alarm sensor object per hour.
Given a false alarm delivered as a sensor object, when its duration is counted, then it is counted if it lasts less than or equal to 2 sensor cycles.

requirement_text: Reintegration of an FCP shall be completed in at most 1.5 minutes.
requirement_text_raw: Reintegration of an FCP shall (3.3.5.21) be completed in at most 1.5 minutes.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want reintegration of an FCP completed in at most 1.5 minutes, so that capacity returns quickly.
technical_task: Complete reintegration of an FCP within 1.5 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCP to be reintegrated, when reintegration runs, then it completes in at most 1.5 minutes.
Given a reintegration that takes longer than 1.5 minutes, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Administrator shall be able to create users, departments, and courses.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to create users, departments and courses, so that the institution's structure is in the system.
technical_task: Provide administrator functions to create users, departments and courses.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator, when the administrator creates a user, a department or a course, then it is saved.
Given a saved user, department or course, when it is listed, then it is shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to contact administrators for feedback or assistance.
user_story: As a user, I want to contact administrators for feedback or assistance, so that I can get help.
technical_task: Offer a way for users to send feedback or assistance requests to administrators.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when the user sends feedback to an administrator, then the administrator receives it.
Given a user, when the user asks for assistance, then the request reaches an administrator.

requirement_text: If the button press is shorter than the LIN cycle time, the signal is to be set to `` TRUE '' for one communication cycle.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the signal set to "TRUE" for one communication cycle when a button press is shorter than the LIN cycle time, so that short presses are not lost.
technical_task: Set the signal to "TRUE" for one communication cycle whenever the button press is shorter than the LIN cycle time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a button press shorter than the LIN cycle time, when it is detected, then the signal is set to "TRUE" for one communication cycle.
Given a button press that is not shorter than the LIN cycle time, when it is detected, then this rule does not apply.

requirement_text: Premium Users shall be permitted to make up to 66 calls per day.
user_story: As a premium user, I want to make up to 66 calls per day, so that I have a defined allowance.
technical_task: Limit Premium Users to 66 calls per day.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Premium User who has made fewer than 66 calls today, when the user makes a call, then it is allowed.
Given a Premium User who has made 66 calls today, when the user tries another call, then it is refused.

requirement_text: The Clinical Decision Support capability should conform to function IN.1.7 (Secure Data Routing) to ensure that the exchange occurs only among authorized senders and receivers.
requirement_text_raw: The  Clinical Decision Support capability should conform to function IN.1.7 (Secure Data Routing)  to ensure that the exchange occurs only among authorized senders and receivers.
user_story: As a security officer, I want the Clinical Decision Support capability to conform to function IN.1.7 (Secure Data Routing), so that data is exchanged only among authorized senders and receivers.
technical_task: Make the Clinical Decision Support capability follow function IN.1.7 (Secure Data Routing) so exchanges involve only authorized senders and receivers.
acceptance_criteria: Given an exchange of data by the Clinical Decision Support capability, when it takes place, then it is only among authorized senders and receivers.
Given a sender or receiver that is not authorized, when it tries to take part, then it is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. IN.1.7 is only referenced.

requirement_text: System shall be able to verify if the user is situated within a 1-mile radius of the campus.
user_story: As a campus administrator, I want the system to verify whether a user is within a 1-mile radius of the campus, so that location-restricted features are limited to nearby users.
technical_task: Check whether the user's location is within a 1-mile radius of the campus.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user within a 1-mile radius of the campus, when the system verifies the location, then the user is recognized as inside the radius.
Given a user farther than 1 mile from the campus, when the system verifies the location, then the user is recognized as outside the radius.
rationale: Role assumed: campus administrator. What the result is used for is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall be able to add a new chemist or lab, with only one lab allowed per pincode.
user_story: As a user, I want to add a new chemist or lab, with only one lab allowed per pincode, so that coverage is not duplicated.
technical_task: Allow adding a chemist or lab and reject a second lab for the same pincode.
acceptance_criteria: Given a pincode with no lab, when the user adds a lab, then the lab is added.
Given a pincode that already has a lab, when the user adds another lab for it, then the addition is refused.

requirement_text: User shall be able to update or edit their profile appearance.
user_story: As a user, I want to update my profile appearance, so that it looks the way I want.
technical_task: Allow users to edit the appearance of their profile.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's profile, when the user edits its appearance, then the change is saved.
Given a saved appearance change, when the profile is viewed, then the new appearance is shown.

requirement_text: System shall enable role-based access control to enforce appropriate permissions for different user roles.
user_story: As an administrator, I want role-based access control, so that each role has the right permissions.
technical_task: Implement role-based access control that assigns permissions per user role.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with a role, when the user performs an action permitted for that role, then the action is allowed.
Given a user with a role, when the user performs an action not permitted for that role, then the action is denied.

requirement_text: The software shall allow users to create precise and intricate designs more easily with a touch-screen enabled tablet/monitor.
rationale: "More easily", "precise" and "intricate" are relative and not measurable.
clarification_questions: How much easier should designs be to create compared with what?
Which touch-screen devices and what precision are meant?

requirement_text: As an option to AAA-batteries the supplier shall propose a concept with smaller batteries.
user_story: As a client, I want the supplier to propose a concept with smaller batteries as an option to AAA batteries, so that I can compare alternatives.
technical_task: Have the supplier propose, as an option, a concept using batteries smaller than AAA.
acceptance_criteria: Given the supplier's proposal, when it is reviewed, then it offers AAA batteries as the baseline.
Given the supplier's proposal, when it is reviewed, then it also includes a concept with smaller batteries as an option.

requirement_text: System shall maintain data elements and rules up to date.
rationale: "Data elements and rules" and "up to date" are not specified.
clarification_questions: Which data elements and rules must be kept up to date?

requirement_text: The TCS will interface with external systems to conduct mission coordination and operations.
user_story: As a mission operator, I want the TCS to interface with external systems, so that missions can be coordinated and operated together.
technical_task: Provide interfaces from the TCS to external systems for mission coordination and operations.
acceptance_criteria: Given an external system, when the TCS communicates with it, then mission coordination information is exchanged.
Given an external system, when the TCS communicates with it, then operations information is exchanged.
rationale: Role assumed: mission operator. The external systems are not named.

requirement_text: There shall be built-in support on the NE for voted resets, including a special packet type for executing the primitive.
requirement_text_raw: There shall (3.2.2.5.1) be built-in support on the NE for voted resets, including a special packet type for executing the primitive.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want built-in NE support for voted resets, including a special packet type to execute the primitive, so that resets can be coordinated.
technical_task: Build voted reset support into the NE, including a special packet type used to execute the voted reset primitive.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NE, when a voted reset is requested, then the NE supports executing it.
Given a voted reset, when it is executed, then a special packet type is used to carry out the primitive.

requirement_text: For defects that cannot be reproduced with the current release and which relate to an earlier release, the contractor shall create at least one test case that verifies the defect in the earlier release.
user_story: As a client, I want the contractor to create a test case that verifies a defect in the earlier release when it cannot be reproduced in the current one, so that the defect can still be checked.
technical_task: For each defect that cannot be reproduced with the current release and relates to an earlier release, create at least one test case that verifies the defect in the earlier release.
acceptance_criteria: Given a defect that cannot be reproduced with the current release and relates to an earlier release, when the contractor handles it, then at least one test case is created.
Given the test case, when it is run against the earlier release, then it verifies the defect.

requirement_text: System shall provide a secure environment for user interaction with the command-line interface.
user_story: As a user, I want a secure environment for interacting with the command-line interface, so that my commands and data are protected.
technical_task: Secure the environment in which the command-line interface is used.
acceptance_criteria: Given the command-line interface, when a user interacts with it, then the interaction takes place in a secure environment.
Given an unauthorized person, when the person tries to use the command-line interface, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The security measures are not specified.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to provide written feedback, rate the app, and share their thoughts after installation.
user_story: As a user, I want to write feedback, rate the app and share my thoughts after installing it, so that developers know my opinion.
technical_task: Offer feedback entry, rating and sharing of thoughts after installation.
acceptance_criteria: Given the app is installed, when the user writes feedback, then the feedback is saved.
Given the app is installed, when the user rates the app or shares thoughts, then the rating or thoughts are saved.

requirement_text: The system shall allow applicants to resubmit revised plans.
user_story: As an applicant, I want to resubmit revised plans, so that I can correct my application.
technical_task: Allow applicants to submit a revised version of their plans.
acceptance_criteria: Given a submitted application, when the applicant resubmits revised plans, then the revised plans are saved.
Given revised plans, when the application is viewed, then the revised plans are shown.
